package carrier_test

import (
	"context"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"net/url"
	"testing"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"

	client "example.com/viewheader/gen/http/probe/client"
	server "example.com/viewheader/gen/http/probe/server"
	svc "example.com/viewheader/gen/probe"
	loomhttp "github.com/CaliLuke/loom/http"
)

type carrierService struct {
	tags svc.Tags
	view string
}

func TestProjectedHeaderCarrier(t *testing.T) {
	for _, view := range []string{"default", "tiny"} {
		for _, tc := range []struct {
			name string
			tags svc.Tags
			wire []string
		}{
			{"absent", nil, nil},
			{"empty", svc.Tags{}, []string{""}},
			{"values", svc.Tags{"red", "blue"}, []string{"red, blue"}},
		} {
			t.Run(view+"/"+tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
				mux := loomhttp.NewMuxer()
				service := carrierService{tags: tc.tags, view: view}
				server.Mount(mux, server.New(svc.NewEndpoints(service), mux, loomhttp.RequestDecoder, loomhttp.ResponseEncoder, nil, nil))
				response := httptest.NewRecorder()
				mux.ServeHTTP(response, httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/", nil))
				require.Equal(t, http.StatusOK, response.Code)
				require.Equal(t, view, response.Header().Get("loom-view"))
				require.Equal(t, tc.wire, response.Header().Values("X-Tags"))
				host := httptest.NewServer(mux)
				t.Cleanup(host.Close)
				u, err := url.Parse(host.URL)
				require.NoError(t, err)
				c := client.NewClient(u.Scheme, u.Host, host.Client(), loomhttp.RequestEncoder, loomhttp.ResponseDecoder, false)
				got, err := c.Show()(t.Context(), nil)
				require.NoError(t, err)
				require.Equal(t, &svc.Card{Tags: tc.tags}, got)
			})
		}
	}
}

func (s carrierService) Show(context.Context) (*svc.Card, string, error) {
	return &svc.Card{Tags: s.tags}, s.view, nil
}
